claims: Banksy is a formally anonymous English street artist.
Banksy emerged from the Bristol underground scene in the 1990s.
A 2026 Reuters investigation linked Banksy to Robin Gunningham.
Robin Gunningham is a man from Bristol.
Robin Gunningham is now in his early 50s.
Robin Gunningham allegedly sometimes used the name David Jones.
Banksy uses a distinctive fast stenciling technique.
Banksy creates art quickly in public spaces to avoid arrest.
Girl with Balloon is a work by Banksy.
Flower Thrower is a work by Banksy.
Banksy's pieces have sold for millions at auction.
In 2018 Banksy shredded his own painting Girl with Balloon immediately after it was sold for £1 million at Sotheby's.
Banksy directed the 2010 Oscar-nominated documentary Exit Through the Gift Shop.
Banksy has long maintained a policy of not confirming his real name
